paragraphs.text: I clothe myself in [the love of the Lord].
His members are with him, and I cling to them, and he loves me.
For I would not have known how to love the Lord if he had not loved me.
Who can understand love except the one who is loved?
I love the Beloved, and my soul loves him. Where his resting place is, there I am too.
I will not be a stranger, because there is no envy with the Lord, the Most High and Merciful.
I have been united with him, because the lover has found the Beloved, so that I may love the Son and become a son.
For whoever joins himself to the one who does not die will himself be free from death.
And whoever takes delight in life will be alive.
This is the Spirit of the Lord, without deceit, who teaches people to know his ways.
Become wise, gain knowledge, and wake up. Hallelujah.
No one changes your holy place, my God, nor can anyone change it and put it in another place.
For no one has authority over it. You conceived your sanctuary before you made the places.
What is older will not be changed by those younger than it. You have given your heart, Lord, to your faithful ones.
You will never cease, nor will you be without fruit.
For one hour of your faithfulness is worth more than all days and years.
For who can clothe himself in your grace and be wronged?
For your seal is known, and your creatures are known to it.
Your hosts hold it, and the chosen archangels are clothed in it.
You have given us fellowship with you, not because you need us, but because we need you.
Sprinkle your drops upon us, and open your abundant springs, which pour out milk and honey for us.
For there is no regret with you, so that you would regret anything you have promised.
And the outcome was revealed to you.
For whatever you gave, you gave freely, so that you would not afterward turn back and take these things away.
For as God, everything was revealed to you, and it was arranged before you from the beginning.
And you, Lord, have made everything. Hallelujah.
I give thanks to you, Lord, (because I love you.)
Most High, do not abandon me, because you are my hope.
I received your grace freely; I will live by it.
Let my persecutors come, but let them not see me.
Let a cloud of gloom fall upon their eyes, and let an atmosphere of thick darkness darken them.
Let them have no light to see by, so that they cannot seize me.
Let their thinking become thick darkness, and let what they have cunningly devised return upon their own heads.
For they devised a plan, but it came to nothing for them.
(They prepared themselves for evil, but were found empty-handed.)
For my hope rests on the Lord, and I will not be afraid.
(And because the Lord is my salvation,) I will not be afraid.
He is like a crown upon my head, and I will not be shaken.
Even if everything is shaken, I will stand firm.
Even if everything visible perishes, I will not die.
Because the Lord is with me, and I am with him. Hallelujah.
Just as the wind moves through a lyre and its strings speak,
so the Spirit of the Lord speaks through my limbs, and I speak through his love.
For he destroys whatever is foreign, and everything belongs to the Lord.
For so it was from the beginning, and will be until the end:
nothing will be opposed to him, and nothing will stand against him.
The Lord increased his knowledge and was eager that the things given to us by his grace should be known.
He gave us his praise for his name; our spirits praise his Holy Spirit.
For a stream came out and became a great, wide river; it swept everything away, crushed it, and brought it to the temple.
And (human barriers) could not hold it back, nor could the skills of those who restrain water.
For it came over the surface of the whole earth, (and filled everything.)
(And all the thirsty people on earth drank), and their thirst was relieved and quenched.
For the drink was given by the Most High.
Blessed, therefore, are the servants of that drink, those who were entrusted with its water.
They soothed dry lips, (and restored the will that had grown weak.)
(And the souls that were close to departing—they held them back from death.)
And the limbs that had fallen, (they straightened and raised up).
They gave strength to their coming, and light to their eyes.
For everyone recognized them in the Lord, and they lived by the living water forever. Hallelujah.
As anger rushes against wickedness, so joy rushes toward the beloved, and he brings in its fruit without restraint.
The Lord is my joy, and my course is toward him; this is my beautiful path.
For I have the Lord as my helper. He made himself known to me without reserve, in his simplicity, for his kindness brought his greatness low.
He became like me so that I might receive him; in appearance he was considered like me so that I might put him on.
And I did not tremble when I saw him, because he was the one who had shown me mercy.
He became like my nature so that I might know him, and like my form so that I would not turn away from him.
The Father of knowledge is the Word of knowledge.
He who created wisdom is wiser than his works.
And he who created me before I came into being knew what I would do when I came into being.
For this reason he showed me mercy in his abundant compassion, and granted me the opportunity to ask of him and receive from his sacrifice.
For he is incorruptible, the fulfillment of the ages and their Father.
He allowed himself to be seen by those who belong to him, so that they might recognize the one who made them and not suppose that they came into being by themselves.
For he established his path for knowledge; he widened it and lengthened it and brought it to complete fulfillment.
And he placed upon it the footprints of his light, and it went from the beginning to the end.
For he was served by him, and found rest in the Son.
And for the sake of his salvation he will take possession of everything, and the Most High will be known among his holy ones.
To bring good news to those who have psalms of the Lord’s coming, so that they may go out to meet him and sing to him with joy and with a lyre of many tones.
Let the seers go before him and be seen before him.
Let them praise the Lord in his love, because he is near and sees.
Be removed from the earth, hatred, and be drowned along with jealousy.
For ignorance has been destroyed, because knowledge of the Lord has come.
Let those who sing of the grace of the Lord Most High sing and offer their psalms.
Let their hearts be like the day, and their melodies like the greatness of the Lord’s beauty.
Let no living being be without knowledge or without a voice.
For he gave his creation a mouth, to raise its voice to him and to praise him.
Acknowledge his power and proclaim his grace. Hallelujah.
Open, open your hearts to the Lord’s joy, and let your love abound from the heart to the lips,
to bring living, holy fruit to the Lord and to speak watchfully in his light.
Rise and stand firm, you who were once brought low.
You who were silent, speak, for your mouths have been opened.
For the Lord’s right hand is with you, and he is your helper.
Peace has been prepared for you before your battle takes place.
Hear the word of truth and receive the knowledge of the Most High.
Let your flesh not know what I tell you, nor your clothing what I show you.
Guard the mystery, you who are guarded by it. [?]
Guard my faith, you who are guarded by it.
And know my knowledge, you who truly know me.
Love me with love, you who love.
For I do not turn away from them. [?]
Before they came into being, I knew them, and I myself stamped their features.
I formed their limbs and prepared my breasts for them, so that they might drink my holy milk and live by it.
I took pleasure in them, and I am not ashamed of them.
For they are my work and the strength of my thoughts.
Who, then, will stand against my work? Or who will refuse to submit to them?
I willed and fashioned the mind and the heart, and they are mine. I placed my chosen ones at my right hand.
My righteousness goes before them, and they will not be deprived of my name, because it is with them.
Ask abundantly, and remain in the love of the Lord.
Be beloved in the Beloved, protected in the one who lives, and redeemed in the one who was redeemed.
And you will be found free from decay through all ages, for the name of your Father. Hallelujah.
Open your ears, and I will speak to you.
Give me your souls, so that I too may give you my soul.
The Lord's word and his wishes are the holy thought that he conceived concerning his Messiah.
For your lives are in the Lord's will, and his purpose is everlasting life, and your fulfillment is without decay.
Become rich in God the Father, and receive the purpose of the Most High. Be strengthened and saved by his grace.
For I proclaim peace to you, his faithful ones, so that all who hear may not fall in battle.
And those who have known him will not perish, and those who receive will not be put to shame.
Truth is an everlasting crown. Blessed are those who place it on their heads.
It is a precious stone, for battles were fought over the crown.
Righteousness took it and gave it to you.
Put on the crown in the Lord's true covenant, and all who have conquered will be recorded in his book.
For their record is your victory. She sees you before her and desires that you be saved. Hallelujah.
The Lord set my mouth right with his word and opened my heart with his light.
He made his deathless life dwell in me and granted me to speak the fruit of his peace,
to turn back the souls of those who wish to come to him, and to lead a good company of captives into freedom.
I was strengthened and made strong, and I took the world captive. This became mine for the praise of the Most High and of God my Father.
The peoples who had been scattered were gathered together, and I was not defiled by my sins, because they acknowledged me in the heights.
Traces of light were placed upon their hearts. They walked in my life and were saved, and they became mine forever and ever. Hallelujah.
My heart was cut open, and its blossom appeared. Grace sprang up in it, and it bore fruit for the Lord.
For the Most High circumcised me by his Holy Spirit, uncovered my innermost being before him, and filled me with his love.
His circumcision became my salvation. (And I ran along the path in his peace, along the path of truth.)
From the beginning to the end, I received knowledge of him.
I was firmly established upon (the rock of truth), where he set me.
Speaking waters approached my lips, (from the Lord’s spring, which gives without grudging.
I drank and became drunk on living waters that do not die.
My drunkenness was not without knowledge; rather, I abandoned empty things.
I turned toward the Most High, my God, and became rich through his gift.
I left folly lying on the ground; I stripped it off and threw it away from me.
The Lord renewed me with his clothing and took possession of me through his light.
(From above he gave me rest free from decay, and I became like land that blossoms and rejoices in its fruit.
And the Lord was like the sun upon the face of the earth.
He illuminated my eyes, and my face received dew.
My breath was refreshed (by the sweet fragrance) of the Lord.
He brought me into his paradise, where the wealth of the Lord’s delight is.
I worshiped the Lord because of his glory.
I said, “Blessed, Lord, are those who are planted in your land, those who have a place in your paradise.
They grow as your trees grow, and they have come out of darkness, beautiful.
[?] who do good works (and turn from wickedness to your kindness).
(They turned the bitterness of the trees away from themselves when they were planted in your land),
[?] and an everlasting memorial of your faithful servants.
For there is ample room in your paradise, and nothing in it is idle; rather, everything is full of fruit.
(Glory to you, God, the delight in everlasting paradise.) Hallelujah.
He filled me with words of truth so that I might speak it.
Like a stream of water, truth flows from my mouth, and my lips declared its fruits.
He increased his knowledge within me, because the mouth of the Lord is the true word and the gateway of his light.
The Most High gave it to his worlds, the interpreters of his beauty and the narrators of his glory, the confessors of his purpose, the proclaimers of his thought, and the instructors in his works.
For the swiftness of the word is beyond description. As its expression is, so too are its swiftness and sharpness, and its course has no limit.
It never falls but stands firm, and we do not know its descent or its way.
For as its work is, so is its outcome, for it is the light and dawn of thought.
Through it the worlds spoke to one another, and those who had been silent came to speech.
From it came friendship and harmony, and they spoke to one another of what they possessed.
They were stirred by the word and knew the one who made them, because they were in harmony.
For the mouth of the Most High spoke to them, and his interpretation sped along by his hand.
For the dwelling place of the word is a human being, and its truth is love.
Blessed are those who through this have come to understand everything and have known the Lord in his truth. Hallelujah.
Look, the Lord is our mirror. Open your eyes and see them in him.
Learn where your faces are, and proclaim praises to his Spirit.
Wipe the paint from your faces, and love his holiness and put it on.
Then you will always be without blemish before him. Hallelujah.
As a son's eyes are on his father, so my eyes, Lord, are always turned toward you.
For my breasts and my delight are with you.
Do not turn your compassion away from me, Lord, and do not take your kindness from me.
Always stretch out your right hand to me, my Lord, and be my guide to the end, according to your will.
May I be pleasing in your sight for the sake of your praise, and may I be delivered from evil for the sake of your name.
May your gentleness, Lord, remain with me, and the fruits of your love.
Teach me the songs of your truth, so that I may bear fruit in you.
Open to me the lyre of your Holy Spirit, so that I may praise you, Lord, with every melody.
Give to me according to the abundance of your mercy, and hurry to grant our requests.
You can meet all our needs. Hallelujah.
Just as the sun is a joy to those who seek its day, so my Lord is my joy.
For he is my sun, and his rays have raised me up, and his light has driven all darkness from before my face.
Through him I gained eyes, and I saw his holy day.
I came to have ears, and I heard his truth.
I came to have an understanding mind, and I was nurtured by his hand.
I left the path of error, went to him, and received salvation from him without begrudging.
He gave to me according to his generosity, and fashioned me according to the greatness of his beauty.
I put on incorruptibility through his name, and stripped off corruption by his grace.
Death was destroyed before my face, and Sheol was abolished by my word.
Life without death sprang up in the Lord’s land and was made known to his faithful ones, And was given without loss to all who trust in him. Hallelujah.
Just as the farmer’s work is the plow, and the helmsman’s work is steering the ship, So my work is the Lord’s psalm, singing his praises.
My craft and my labor are in his praises, because his love nourished my heart, and its fruit welled up to my lips.
For the Lord is my love; therefore I will sing to him.
For I am strengthened by his praises, and I have faith in him.
I will open my mouth, and his Spirit will speak through me of the Lord’s praise and beauty,
The work of his hands and the labor of his fingers,
The abundance of his mercy and the power of his word.
For the word of the Lord searches out what cannot be seen and reveals his thought.
For the eye sees his works, and the ear hears his thought.
He spread out the earth and placed the waters in the sea.
He stretched out the heavens and set the stars in place.
He ordered creation and established it, and he rested from his works.
Created things run their courses and carry out their tasks, and they do not know how to stop or cease.
And the heavenly powers submit to his word.
The sun is the storehouse of light, and the night is the storehouse of darkness.
He made the sun for the day, so that it would be bright, and he brings night for darkness over the face of the earth.
In their opposition to one another, they proclaim the beauty of God.
There is nothing outside the Lord, because he existed before anything came into being.
The worlds came into being through his word and through the thought of his heart.
Praise and honor to his name. Hallelujah.
I was crowned by my God, and my crown is living.
I was justified by my Lord, and my salvation is imperishable.
I was freed from worthless things, and I am not condemned.
The bonds choking me were cut by her hands. I received the face and likeness of a new person, and I walked in it and was saved.
The thought of truth led me, and I followed it and did not go astray.
Everyone who saw me was amazed, and I seemed to them like a stranger.
And he who knew (and raised me) is the Most High in all his perfection.
He glorified me in his kindness and raised my understanding to the height of truth.
From there he gave me the path of his steps, and I opened doors that had been shut.
I broke through iron bars, and my iron grew hot and melted before me.
Nothing appeared closed to me, because I was the one who opened everything.
I went to all my prisoners to release them, so that I would leave no one bound (bound, who binds [?]).
And I gave my knowledge without envy, and my prayer in my love.
And I sowed my fruit in their hearts, and transformed them through myself.
And they received my blessing and lived; they gathered to me and were saved.
For they became my members, and I am their head.
Praise to you, our head, the Lord Christ. Hallelujah.
My heart was lifted up and enriched in the love of the Most High, so that I might praise him through my name.
My limbs were strengthened, so that they would not fall away from his power.
Sicknesses were removed from my body, and it stood before the Lord according to his will, because his kingdom is true.
Lord, do not take your word away from me because of those who are deficient.
Nor withhold your perfection from me because of their deeds.
Let light not be overcome by darkness, nor let truth flee from falsehood.
May your right hand establish our salvation in victory, receive us from every place, and protect us from everyone held captive by evil.
You are my God; falsehood and death are not in your mouth, but perfection is your will.
And you do not know emptiness, because neither does it know you.
And you do not know error, because neither does it know you.
And ignorance appeared like dust, and like the foam of the sea.
And empty people thought it was great; they too became like it and were emptied.
But those who knew understood and reflected, and were not defiled in their thoughts.
For they were in the mind of the Most High, and laughed at those who walk in error.
And they spoke the truth through the breath that the Most High breathed into them.
Praise and majestic splendor to his name. Hallelujah.
A cup of milk was offered to me, and I drank it in the sweetness of the Lord’s kindness.
The Son is the cup, the Father is the one who was milked, and the Holy Spirit is the one who milked him.
For his breasts were full, and it was not intended that his milk should be poured out for nothing.
The Holy Spirit opened her bosom and mixed the milk from the Father’s two breasts.
And she gave the mixture to the world without their knowing it, and those who receive it in its fullness are those at the right hand.
(The virgin’s womb embraced it, and she conceived and gave birth.
And the virgin became a mother through great mercy.)
And she went into labor and bore a son without pain, because it did not happen in vain.
And she did not seek a midwife, because he gave her life.
Like a man, she gave birth willingly; she gave birth as a demonstration, and gained possession with great power.
And she loved in salvation, guarded in kindness, and revealed in greatness. Hallelujah.
I am a priest of the Lord, and it is him that I serve as priest.
And I offer him the offering of his thought.
For his thought was not like the world, nor like the flesh, nor like those who serve in a fleshly way.
The offering of the Lord is righteousness, and purity of heart and lips.
Offer your kidneys without blemish. Do not let your affections oppress other affections, and do not let your soul oppress another soul.
Do not buy a stranger with your own lifeblood. [?] And do not deprive him of the covering for his nakedness.
But put on the grace of the Lord without envy, and come into his paradise, and make yourself a crown from his tree.
And put it on your head and rejoice, and rest upon his tranquility.
And his praise will go before you, and you will receive from his kindness and his grace, and you will truly be anointed with the praise of his holiness.
Praise and honor to his name. Hallelujah.
I raised my arms on high, toward the mercy of the Lord.
For he cast my bonds off me, and my helper raised me up to his mercy and his salvation.
And I took off darkness and put on light.
And I came to have limbs for my soul, with no pain in them, nor distress nor suffering.
And the Lord’s thought became a great help to me, as did his fellowship, which is imperishable.
And I was lifted up in the light, and passed before his face.
And I was drawing near and giving thanks to him. ...
My heart overflowed and was found in my mouth, and shone upon my lips.
And may it grow in the presence of the Lord’s joy and praise. Hallelujah.
He who brings down from on high and raises me up (from the depths).
And he who gathers the things in between and brings them to me.
He who scattered my enemies and my adversaries.
He who gave me authority over bonds, so that I might loosen them.
He who overthrew the seven-headed dragon by my hands; and you set me over its roots so that I might destroy its offspring.
You were there and helped me, and everywhere your name surrounded me.
Your right hand destroyed (the venom of evil), and your hand leveled a path for those who believe in you.
(And you chose them) from the graves, (and you set them apart) from the dead.
You took dead bones and clothed them with bodies.
They were not moving, and you gave life the power to act.
Your way and your presence were without corruption. You brought your world to corruption, so that everything might be dissolved and renewed.
And your rock will be a foundation for everything. On it you built your kingdom, and it became a dwelling place for the holy ones. Hallelujah.
Joy belongs to the holy ones, and who will clothe themselves in it except them alone?
Grace belongs to the chosen, and who will receive it except those who have trusted in it from the beginning?
Love belongs to the chosen, and who will clothe themselves in it except those who have possessed it from the beginning?
Walk in the knowledge of the Lord, and you will know the Lord’s ungrudging grace, his joy, and the fullness of his knowledge.
His thought became like a letter, and its purpose descended from on high.
It was sent like an arrow from a bow, shot with force.
Many hands rushed toward the letter to snatch it, take it, and read it.
But it escaped their fingers, and they were afraid of it and of the seal upon it.
For they were not permitted to undo its seal, because the power upon the seal was greater than they were.
But those who saw the letter followed it, to learn where it would settle, who would read it, and who would listen to it.
But a wheel received it, and it came onto the wheel.
And with it was a sign of kingship and governance.
And everything that disturbed the wheel, it mowed down and cut off.
And it gathered a multitude who were opponents, and buried and uprooted many forests,
and made a broad road. ...
The head descended to the feet, because the wheel had run down to the feet, along with whatever came upon it.
It was a letter of command, and because all the regions had been gathered together.
And at its head appeared the Head who had been revealed, and the true Son from the exalted Father.
And he inherited and received everything, and the plan of many was thwarted.
But all the deceivers grew bold and fled, and the persecutors were extinguished and wiped out.
And the letter became a great book, written in full by the finger of God.
And the name of the Father was upon it, and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, to reign forever and ever. Hallelujah.
The dove flew over the head of our Lord Christ, because he was her head.
And she sang over him, and her voice was heard.
And the inhabitants were afraid, and the resident foreigners were shaken.
The flying creature dropped its wings, and every creeping creature died in its burrow.
And the depths were opened and covered, and they sought the Lord like women giving birth.
And he was not given to them as food, because he did not belong to them.
But the depths were submerged in the Lord’s submersion, and they perished in that thought they had held from the beginning.
For they had been in labor from the beginning, and the outcome of their labor was life.
And everyone among them who was deficient perished, because they had no answer to give that would allow them to remain.
And the Lord destroyed the thoughts of all those who had no truth.
For those who were proud in their hearts lacked wisdom.
And they were rejected, because they had no truth.
For the Lord revealed his way and spread his grace abroad.
And those who recognized it know his holiness. Hallelujah.
I escaped from my bonds and fled to you, my God.
(Because you became the right hand of salvation,) and my helper.
You restrained those who stood against me, and they (were seen no more).
For your presence was with me, which saved me by your grace.
But I was despised and rejected in the eyes of many, and in their eyes I was like lead.
Strength and help came to me from you.
You placed a lamp for me on my right and on my left, so that nothing in me would be without light.
I was clothed with the covering of your Spirit, and I took off my garments of skin.
For your right hand lifted me up, and you took sickness away from me.
I became strong through your truth and holy through your righteousness.
(All who opposed me were afraid of me,) and I became the Lord’s in the name of the Lord.
I was justified by his kindness, and his rest lasts forever and ever. Hallelujah.
I will pour out praise to the Lord, because I belong to him.
I will sing his holy song, because my heart is turned toward him.
For his lyre is in my hands, and the songs of his rest will not fall silent.
I will cry out to him with all my heart; I will praise and exalt him with every part of my body.
For from east to west, praise belongs to him.
And from south to north, thanksgiving belongs to him.
And from the summit of the heights to their farthest end, his perfection extends.
Who can write the songs of the Lord, or who can read them?
Or who can guide his soul toward life, so that his soul may be saved?
Or who can rest upon the Most High, so as to speak from his mouth?
Who can explain the wonders of the Lord? For the one who explains will pass away, but the one who is explained will remain.
For it is enough to know and to rest, for the singers stand at rest.
Like a river with an abundant spring, flowing to help those who seek it. Hallelujah.
I stretched out my hands and declared my Lord holy.
For the stretching out of my hands is his sign.
And my outstretched form is an upright tree. Hallelujah.
Like the wings of doves over their young, and the mouths of their young turned toward their mouths, so also are the wings of the Spirit over my heart.
My heart delights and leaps, like a baby leaping in its mother's womb.
I believed, and therefore I also found rest, because the one in whom I believed is faithful.
He has blessed me abundantly, and my head is turned toward him.
No sword will separate me from him, nor will any saber.
For I was prepared before destruction came, and I was placed in his imperishable arms.
And deathless life embraced me and kissed me.
The spirit within me comes from that life, and it cannot [?] die, because it is life.
Those who saw me were amazed, because I was persecuted.
And they thought I had been swallowed up, because I appeared to them like one of the lost.
But the oppression I suffered became salvation for me.
And I became an object of contempt to them, because there was no jealousy in me.
Because I was doing good to everyone, I was hated.
They surrounded me like mad dogs that unknowingly turn against their masters.
For their understanding is corrupt, and their thinking is distorted.
But I held water in my right hand, and I bore their bitterness with my sweetness.
And I did not perish, because I was not their brother, nor indeed was my birth like theirs.
They sought my death but could not find it, because I was older than their memory, and they blew against me in vain.
And those who came after me tried in vain to destroy the memory of the one who was before them.
For the thought of the Most High cannot be anticipated, and his heart surpasses all wisdom. Hallelujah.
The Lord is my hope; I will not be put to shame in him.
For he made me according to his glory, and according to his grace he also gave to me.
And according to his mercy he raised me up, and in the greatness of his beauty he exalted me.
And he brought me up from the depths of Sheol and drew me out of the mouth of death.
And I humbled my enemies.
And he justified me by his grace, for I believed in the Lord’s Messiah.
And it was revealed to me that he is the Lord, and he showed me his sign.
And he led me by his light and gave me the staff of his might, so that I might subdue the thoughts of the nations and humble the strength of mighty men.
To wage war by his word and gain victory by his power.
And the Lord cast down my enemy by his word, and he became like chaff carried away by the wind.
And I gave praise to the Most High, because he exalted his servant and the son of his maidservant. Hallelujah.
Draw water for yourselves from the Lord’s living spring, because it has been opened for you.
And come, all you who are thirsty, and take a drink, and find rest beside the Lord’s spring.
For it is beautiful and pure, and it refreshes the soul.
For its waters are much sweeter than honey, and the bees’ honeycomb cannot compare with it.
For it flows from the Lord’s lips, and from the Lord’s heart it received its name.
And it came without limit and unseen, and until it was placed in their midst, they did not know it.
Blessed are those who have drunk from it and found rest in it. Hallelujah.
The depths dissolved before the Lord, and darkness was held back by his appearance.
Error went astray and perished before him, and contempt (was seized by an inability to move, and sank) before the Lord’s truth.
He opened his mouth and spoke grace and joy, and uttered a new song of praise to his name.
And he raised his voice to the Most High and presented to him the children who were in his hand.
And his person was vindicated, because his holy Father had granted him this.
Come out, you who have suffered oppression, and receive joy.
And possess your souls through grace, and receive for yourselves life without death.
And they condemned me when I stood, though I was not guilty.
And they divided the plunder taken from me, though nothing was owed to them.
But I endured and remained silent and calm, so that I would not be shaken by them.
But I stood unshaken, like a firm rock that is battered by towering waves and endures.
And I endured their bitterness with humility, so that I might redeem my people and claim them as my inheritance.
And so that I would not make void the promises to the patriarchs, which I had made for the salvation of their descendants. Hallelujah.
For the blessed, joy comes from their hearts, and light from the one who dwells in them.
And a word comes from the Truth, who came into being from himself.
For he was strengthened by the holy power of the Most High, and he remains unshaken forever and ever. Hallelujah.
But grace ran again and left the destroyer behind, and descended upon him to empty him.
And he destroyed destruction before him and ruined its entire structure.
And he stood on a high summit and sent out his voice from one end of the earth to the other.
And he drew to himself all who obeyed him, and he did not appear as an evildoer.
But a perfect virgin stood, proclaiming, calling out, and saying:
“You sons of men, turn back, and you their daughters, come!
Leave the ways of this destroyer and draw near to me.
And I will enter you, bring you out of destruction, and teach you wisdom in the ways of truth.
You will not be corrupted, nor will you perish.
Listen to me and be saved, for I proclaim the grace of God among you.
Through my hands you will be saved and become blessed. I am your judge.
Those who have clothed themselves with me will not suffer injustice, but will possess incorruptibility in the new world.
My chosen ones, walk in me. I will make my ways known to those who seek me, and I will cause them to trust in my name.” Hallelujah.
There is no difficult path where the heart is sincere, nor any wound where thoughts are upright.
Nor is there a storm in the depths of enlightened thought.
Where one is surrounded on every side by beauty, there is nothing divided.
The likeness of what is below is what is above.
For everything is above, and below there is nothing. It only seems otherwise to those who have no knowledge.
Grace has been revealed for your salvation. Believe, live, and be saved. Hallelujah.
The Lord's dew gently overshadowed me, and he raised a cloud of peace above my head.
It guarded me at all times and became salvation for me.
Everything was shaken and thrown into turmoil, and smoke and judgment came out of them.
But I was quiet within the Lord's order, and he was more than a shelter to me, and more than a foundation.
I was carried like a child by its mother, and the Lord's dew gave me milk.
I grew through his gift and found rest in his perfection.
I stretched out my hands as my soul ascended; it was directed toward the Most High, and I was saved in its presence. Hallelujah.
I rested upon the Spirit of the Lord, and she lifted me to the heights.
She set me on my feet in the Lord's height, before his perfection and his glory, as I was glorified in the harmony of his songs.
She gave birth to me before the Lord's presence, and although I am human, I was called the shining one, the Son of God.
I am glorified among the glorious, and I am great among the great.
For according to the greatness of the Most High, so you made me, and according to his renewal he renewed me.
He anointed me from his perfection, and I became one of those close to him.
My mouth opened like a cloud of dew, and my heart poured out an outpouring of righteousness.
My approach was in peace, and I was made firm by the Spirit of guidance. Hallelujah.
I stretched out my hands toward the Lord, and raised my voice to the Most High.
I spoke with the lips of my heart, and he heard me when my voice reached him.
His word came to me, giving me the fruits of my labors.
He gave me rest through the Lord's grace. Hallelujah.
I climbed into the light of truth as into a chariot, and Truth led me and brought me along.
He brought me across pits and cracks, and rescued me from cliffs and waves.
He became a harbor of salvation for me and set me upon the step of immortal life.
He went with me, gave me rest, and did not let me go astray, because he was and is Truth.
I faced no danger because I walked with him, and I did not go astray in anything because I obeyed him.
For error fled from him and did not encounter him.
But Truth was walking on a straight path, and he showed me everything I did not know:
all the poisons of error, and those torments that are thought to be the sweetness of death.
And I saw the corrupter of corruption, as the corrupt bride was adorning herself, and the bridegroom who corrupts and is corrupted.
And I asked Truth who these were, and he said to me, “This is the Deceiver and Error.
They imitate the Beloved and his bride, and they deceive the world and corrupt it.
They invite many to the banquet and give them the wine of their intoxication to drink.
They make them vomit up their wisdom and their knowledge, and leave them without understanding.
Then they abandon them, and they wander about, acting wildly and corrupting,
with no understanding in them, for they do not even seek it.”
But I became wise, so that I would not fall into the hands of deceivers, and I rejoiced within myself because Truth was walking with me.
And I was made firm, and I lived and was saved, and my foundations were laid upon the hand of the Lord,
because he planted me. For he set the root, watered it, established it, and blessed it.
Its fruits last forever. (It grew deep, rose, and spread out.) It became full and grew great.
And the Lord alone was glorified in his planting and in his cultivation,
in his care and in the blessing of his lips, in the beautiful planting of his right hand,
in the abundance of his planting, and in the understanding of his mind. Hallelujah.
Mighty rivers are the power of the Lord; they sweep away headlong those who despise him.
They trip up their steps and ruin their crossings.
They snatch away their bodies and destroy their souls.
For they are swifter than lightning and move swiftly.
But those who cross them in faith will not be shaken.
And those who walk through them without fault will not be troubled.
For the sign in them is the Lord, and the sign is the way for those who cross in the name of the Lord.
Therefore put on the name of the Most High and know him, and you will cross without danger, as the rivers submit to you.
The Lord bridged them by his word, and he walked across them on foot.
And his footprints remain upon the water and have not been destroyed; rather, they are like wood firmly fixed in place.
On this side and that the waves were rising, but the footprints of our Lord Christ remain.
They are neither erased nor destroyed.
A path has been laid for those who follow him, for those who keep to the course of his faith and worship his name. Hallelujah.
As honey drips from the bees’ honeycomb, and milk flows from a woman who loves her children, so my hope rests on you, my God.
As a spring pours out its water, so my heart pours out the praise of the Lord, and my lips bring forth praise to him.
My tongue is sweet with words about him, and my limbs [?] are enriched by his songs.
My face rejoices in his gladness, my spirit exults in his love, and my soul shines in him.
Let the fearful trust in him, and let salvation be made secure in him.
His gain is life without death, and those who receive it are beyond decay. Hallelujah.
Let all his children praise the Lord, and let us receive the truth of his faith.
Let his sons be known to him; therefore let us sing in his love.
We live in the Lord through his grace, and we receive life in his Messiah.
For a great day has dawned upon us, and wonderful is he who has given us a share of his glory.
Therefore let us all unite in the name of the Lord, and let us honor him in his goodness.
Let our faces shine in his light, and let our hearts meditate on his love, by night and by day.
Let us exult in the gladness of the Lord.
Let all who see me marvel, because I am of another race.
For the Father of truth remembered me, he who possessed me from the beginning.
For his riches gave birth to me, and so did the thought of his heart.
His Word is with us throughout our journey, the Savior who gives life and does not despise our souls.
A man who was humbled and was exalted through his own righteousness.
The Son of the Most High appeared in the fullness of his Father.
And light dawned from the Word, which had been in him from long ago.
The Messiah is truly one, and he was known before the foundations of the world. ...
To give life to souls forever through the truth of his name. A new song of praise to the Lord from those who love him. Hallelujah.
I stretched out my hands and drew near to my Lord, because the stretching out of my hands is his sign.
My outstretched arms are an outstretched tree. I was hung upon the path of the upright.
I became of no use to those who know me, because I will hide myself from those who did not hold on to me.
And I will be with those who love me.
All my persecutors died, and those who placed their hope in me sought me, because I am alive.
I arose and am with them, and I will speak through their mouths.
For they despised those who persecuted them, and I laid the yoke of my love upon them.
Like the bridegroom’s arm upon the bride, so is my yoke upon those who know me.
Like a bridal canopy stretched over a bride and groom, so is my love over those who believe in me.
I was not rejected, even though I was thought to be, and I did not perish, even though they imagined it of me.
Sheol saw me and was distressed, and Death sent me back, and many with me.
I became vinegar and gall to it, and I descended with it as far as its depths reached.
It let go of feet and head, because it could not endure my presence.
I formed a gathering of the living among its dead, and I spoke to them with living lips, so that my word would not be without effect.
Those who had died ran to me and cried out, saying, “Have mercy on us, Son of God!
Deal with us according to your kindness, and bring us out of the bonds of darkness.
Open a door for us through which we may come out to you, for we see that our death cannot approach you.
Let us too be saved with you, because you are our Savior.”
I heard their voice and took their faith to heart.
I placed my name upon their heads, because they are free and they are mine. Hallelujah.
